set -eu
if ! id clusterops >/dev/null 2>&1; then sudo useradd --create-home --shell /bin/bash clusterops; fi
sudo install -d -m 700 -o clusterops -g clusterops /home/clusterops/.ssh

sudo cp /etc/hosts /etc/hosts.ssh-cluster.bak
sudo awk '
  $0 == "# BEGIN SSH-CLUSTER MANAGED" {skip=1; next}
  $0 == "# END SSH-CLUSTER MANAGED" {skip=0; next}
  !skip {print}
' /etc/hosts | sudo tee /etc/hosts.ssh-cluster.tmp >/dev/null
{
  printf '%s\n' "# BEGIN SSH-CLUSTER MANAGED"
  printf '%s\n' "$CLUSTER_HOSTS"
  printf '%s\n' "# END SSH-CLUSTER MANAGED"
} | sudo tee -a /etc/hosts.ssh-cluster.tmp >/dev/null
sudo install -m 644 -o root -g root /etc/hosts.ssh-cluster.tmp /etc/hosts
sudo rm -f /etc/hosts.ssh-cluster.tmp
id clusterops
getent hosts node1 node2 node3
sudo -u clusterops test -s /home/clusterops/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub
printf 'public_key_ready=%s\n' "$NODE_NAME"
